scenarios.name: Brakes worn
scenarios.description: Start both pools: the flow conditions on "Inspect bike" route exactly like the inclusive gateway below.

scenarios.name: Brakes and tires worn
scenarios.description: Two conditions are true, so the task starts two tokens, like an inclusive gateway would.

scenarios.name: Nothing worn
scenarios.description: No condition is true: the default flow goes straight to the repair.

scenarios.name: Inspection incomplete
scenarios.description: The inspection does not report tiresWorn. The condition fails and the token stays at the task, as Camunda 7 would refuse to leave it. Set tiresWorn in the instance variables to continue.
